newsitem.title: USA: ORBITAL GETS $41.5 MLN AIR FORCE CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: ORBITAL GETS $41.5 MLN AIR FORCE CONTRACT.

text.p: Orbital Sciences Corp's Orbital Imaging Corp said Thursday it received an about $41.5 million contract from the U.S. Air Force for technology and services from its OrbView-3 satellite system.

The contract for the U.S. Air Force's Warfighter-1 advanced technology demonstration program includes purchases during the first three years of the satellite's five-year lifetime. The company said the contract is for Hyperspectral imagery, which is a technology that enables the detection of ground targets and conditions that would not be seen by other satellite sensor systems.

The company said the satellite imagery to be delivered under the Warfighter-1 program will provide a technology demonstration that will lay the groundwork for U.S. armed forces' use of satellite surveillance data in tactical military applications.
The company said it has now finalized major pre-launch contracts totaling nearly $125 million for imagery and related system sales for its OrbView-1, -2 and -3 satellite network.
Orbital designs and markets space-technology products and satellite-based services, including launch vehicles and spacecraft.
